thesis: The page is a service ticket: every section is one timestamped entry on a vertical clock rail, and the pinned condenser photo crops to the part named in that entry.

signature.name: Ticket Clock Rail
signature.summary: A 2px sage-green vertical rule with mono timestamp pills that light on scroll; pinned hero photo pans/crops per entry; sample-reading chips echo the format in proof.

palette.family: Desert Charcoal + Saltbush Sage + Sodium Signal

motion.intro: Ticket header lines print in sequence; pinned photo fades up from black. ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Clock rail timestamps light on scroll; pinned photo pans/crops per entry (dial)
Sample-reading chips count up once in view (count)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX from left, 200ms, hover:hover only
